# Gateway API Reference

Gateway security is enforced by one middleware: `/health` bypasses auth, `/v1/*` reads are local-read routes, and `/v1/*` mutations are bearer-mutation routes with an explicit loopback development bypass.

DTO package: `github.com/billyhargroveofficial/billyharness/internal/gatewayapi`.

| Method | Path                                             | Auth            | Request                     | Response                   | Summary                                         |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------------ | --------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| GET    | /health                                          | public          | -                           | HealthResponse             | Return minimal process health                   |
| GET    | /ready                                           | public          | -                           | ReadinessResponse          | Return readiness checks and catalog status      |
| POST   | /v1/auth/codex/import                            | bearer-mutation | CodexImportRequest          | credentials.ProviderStatus | Import Codex OAuth credentials                  |
| POST   | /v1/auth/deepseek                                | bearer-mutation | DeepSeekAuthRequest         | credentials.ProviderStatus | Save a DeepSeek API key                         |
| GET    | /v1/auth/status                                  | local-read      | -                           | credentials.Status         | Return redacted provider credential status      |
| GET    | /v1/config                                       | local-read      | -                           | ConfigStatusResponse       | Return effective config with provenance         |
| GET    | /v1/jobs                                         | local-read      | -                           | JobListResponse            | List durable multi-agent jobs                   |
| POST   | /v1/jobs                                         | bearer-mutation | CreateJobRequest            | JobResponse                | Create a bounded durable multi-agent job        |
| GET    | /v1/jobs/{id}                                    | local-read      | -                           | JobResponse                | Fetch a durable multi-agent job                 |
| GET    | /v1/jobs/{id}/artifacts                          | local-read      | -                           | JobArtifactPage            | Page durable job artifacts                      |
| GET    | /v1/jobs/{id}/attempts                           | local-read      | -                           | JobAttemptPage             | Page durable job attempts                       |
| POST   | /v1/jobs/{id}/cancel                             | bearer-mutation | {}                          | JobResponse                | Persist operator cancellation for a durable job |
| POST   | /v1/jobs/{id}/pause                              | bearer-mutation | {}                          | JobResponse                | Pause a durable job at a safe boundary          |
| POST   | /v1/jobs/{id}/resume                             | bearer-mutation | {}                          | JobResponse                | Resume a paused or waiting durable job          |
| POST   | /v1/jobs/{id}/run                                | bearer-mutation | {}                          | JobResponse                | Start or re-admit a durable job                 |
| GET    | /v1/mcp                                          | local-read      | -                           | mcpstatus.Response         | Return MCP status snapshot                      |
| GET    | /v1/processes                                    | local-read      | -                           | ManagedProcessResponse     | Return managed shell processes                  |
| POST   | /v1/run                                          | bearer-mutation | RunRequest                  | NDJSON protocol.Event      | Run a one-shot prompt stream                    |
| GET    | /v1/sessions                                     | local-read      | -                           | SessionListResponse        | List gateway sessions                           |
| POST   | /v1/sessions                                     | bearer-mutation | CreateSessionRequest        | SessionResponse            | Create a gateway session                        |
| GET    | /v1/sessions/{id}                                | local-read      | -                           | SessionResponse            | Fetch a session snapshot                        |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/cancel                         | bearer-mutation | -                           | CancelSessionResponse      | Cancel an active session run                    |
| GET    | /v1/sessions/{id}/context                        | local-read      | -                           | SessionContextResponse     | Inspect session context accounting              |
| GET    | /v1/sessions/{id}/events                         | local-read      | -                           | NDJSON protocol.Event      | Replay or follow session events                 |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/inputs                         | bearer-mutation | SessionInputRequest         | SessionInputResponse       | Admit a queued session input                    |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/inputs/{input_id}/complete     | bearer-mutation | SessionInputCompleteRequest | SessionInputResponse       | Mark a queued input terminal                    |
| GET    | /v1/sessions/{id}/inspect                        | local-read      | -                           | SessionInspectResponse     | Inspect stored session diagnostics              |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/redo                           | bearer-mutation | -                           | SessionUndoResponse        | Redo the latest reverted filesystem change      |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/run                            | bearer-mutation | RunRequest                  | NDJSON protocol.Event      | Run a prompt inside an existing session         |
| GET    | /v1/sessions/{id}/status                         | local-read      | -                           | SessionStatus              | Fetch a compact session status                  |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/undo                           | bearer-mutation | SessionUndoRequest          | SessionUndoResponse        | Undo the latest recorded filesystem change      |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/user_input/{request_id}/answer | bearer-mutation | UserInputAnswerRequest      | UserInputResponse          | Answer a pending user-input request             |
| POST   | /v1/sessions/{id}/user_input/{request_id}/reject | bearer-mutation | UserInputRejectRequest      | UserInputResponse          | Reject a pending user-input request             |
| GET    | /v1/tools                                        | local-read      | -                           | []protocol.ToolSpec        | Return native tool catalog                      |
